published_ranges._notes: Specs from anycubic.au and eu.anycubic3d.com PVA pages. Max volumetric speed and HDT printed as '/' (not published). Diameter from Anycubic Official Store Amazon listing B0H6M51GHG; no tolerance published. Bambu parent not confirmed.
